settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.subtitle: Shop settings that apply to every customer.
settingsPage.blikDescription: The phone number customers send a BLIK transfer to when paying for a consultation.
settingsPage.notSet: No BLIK number is set — customers will be told payment details are coming soon.
settingsPage.phoneHint: E.g. +48 600 123 456 — spaces and dashes are fine. Leave empty to remove it.
settingsPage.recipientHint: E.g. BOBR Sp. z o.o. — 2 to 100 characters. Optional.
settingsPage.saveFailed: Could not save the BLIK details.
settingsPage.zonesNote: One-time shipping is now set per delivery zone.
settingsPage.blikRequirement: The number must be registered to receive BLIK phone transfers in your bank's app, linked to the account the money should go to — otherwise customers are told the number does not accept BLIK transfers. Not every bank allows a business account. Payments are not confirmed automatically: check your bank and mark the consultation as paid.

consultationsPage.title: Consultations
consultationsPage.subtitleStaff: Every booking, newest first. Confirm a time and a Google Meet link.
consultationsPage.confirmDescription: Pick a time (Warsaw time) and paste the Google Meet link.
consultationsPage.meetUrlInvalid: That is not a Google Meet link. Required format: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij
consultationsPage.dateTimeRequired: Pick a date and a time.
consultationsPage.completeBody: Marks the consultation as held. This cannot be undone.
consultationsPage.cancelBody: The booking will be cancelled. This cannot be undone.
consultationsPage.paidFailed: Could not change the payment status.

zonesPage.title: Delivery zones
zonesPage.subtitle: Postal codes we deliver to, and the shipping price for one-time orders. Calendar orders always ship free.
zonesPage.matching: A postal code goes to the active zone with the longest matching prefix — e.g. "00" covers 00-000…00-999, while "00-9" covers only 00-900…00-999.
zonesPage.none: No zones yet. Without an active zone, orders with an address are refused.
zonesPage.name: Name
zonesPage.prefixesHint: Separate with commas or spaces, e.g. 00, 01, 02-9. 1 to 5 digits; the dash is ignored.
zonesPage.priceHint: In złoty, at most two decimal places — e.g. 15.00
zonesPage.priceInvalid: Enter an amount in złoty, e.g. 15.00 — at most two decimal places.
zonesPage.toggleFailed: Could not change the zone status.
